moworks.notes: Idea and numbers (TakayuStudio catalog-ui-loading-gradient-arc, written here): Ring r40 with a 7 px grey track. Comet arc 288° (1.6π) of 7 px accent whose opacity falls from 1 at the head to 0 at the tail as (1 − s)^1.6; head dot r3.5. Rotates clockwise, linear, 1.4 s per turn; 'LOADING' at the centre. Params: period (1.4 s / vòng) · arc (288°) · radius (40 px) · stroke (7 px). The tail's opacity falls from the head as (1 − s)^1.6.
